evidence.quote: We have come far from the worst moments of the crisis, and the economy continues to improve.
But the effects of the recession are still being felt by many families, particularly those that had very little in savings and other assets beforehand.
The Federal Reserve's mission is to promote a healthy economy and strong financial system, and that is why we have promoted and will continue to promote asset-building.
